name: autocomplete
title: Autocomplete
description: Free text with suggestions: the text is the value, and the list only helps finish it. Combobox's well, frosted plate and rows; suggestions that start with what you typed come first, and the rest of the best match is drawn after the caret, where Tab or → takes it. Nothing matched closes the plate; a search you run has Combobox's loading and failed rows; recent searches before typing.
docs: Agent guide: https://metalui.dev/r/autocomplete.md. SwiftUI: MetalAutocomplete in the MetalUI Swift package.
